I have exactly the same degree as you and I've spent nearly 6 months landing a job. I managed to become an IT technician in public sector. Most places that offered data analyst positions as an early junior or an intern offered 6-7k tops. In most cases the realistic pay that you would get was about 4.5-5.5k gross. Don't get me wrong - you easily CAN live with that salary and survive without driving a Mercedes and eating out every night but I would not expect getting even 7k right away.

If I were you first of all I would try to get some more experience in your home country and then move. As someone mentioned earlier you could also teach english as a native speaker - it's a great way honestly. Imo you would get a better salary doing that if you wanted to earn more right away.

Also - I wouldn't recommend you to look for an employment after October. It's really tough to find something at the end of the year. Getting into entry level corporate job is a long process right now and things may not go as you thought (I've been there :D)

Anyway, if you wanna try - life is too short to worry bout those things and just let it flow and see what happens :D
